instruction: Add 'Strategic Plan' as the title on slide one and format it with a 32-point font.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding title 'Strategic Plan' with font size 32 points to the first slide. Evaluator checks if the text exists with the correct font size. Custom getter extracts all text and font properties (including font size in points) from the first slide, and custom metric verifies the text exists with font size of 32 points (allowing 1 point tolerance for rounding).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: text 'Strategic Plan' exists and has font size of 32 points
Getter properly extracts text and font properties from first slide (slide_index: 0), correctly converting font size to points using run.font.size.pt
Metric correctly handles expected parameter (direct access to rules dict, not expected.get('rules'))
Postconfig appropriately saves file with Ctrl+S before verification, ensuring getter reads persisted changes
Font size tolerance of 1 point is reasonable for handling rounding issues
Case-insensitive text matching is practical and appropriate
Logic handles edge cases correctly: returns 0.0 if result is empty or shapes missing
